results.title: All 13 data endpoints refuse anonymous requests (401)
JWT signed with a different secret is rejected
Unsigned JWT (alg: none) is rejected
Tampered payload (Staff token edited to role OWNER, original signature) is rejected
Expired access token is rejected
Token confusion: the Google OAuth "state" token cannot be used as an API access token
Login brute force: 6th attempt locked (via nginx, X-Forwarded-For spoofing ignored)
Login brute force cannot be bypassed by rotating source IPs (API not exposed; per-account lockout)
Password spraying: many accounts × 1 password is throttled globally
No account enumeration: same message and similar timing for existing vs unknown email
Refresh-token theft: replaying a rotated token after the grace window kills the whole session family
Refresh cookie is HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, scoped to /api/v1/auth
results.note: Secure flag off (COOKIE_SECURE=false for local http) — must be true in production

results.title: Deactivating a user ends their access immediately
Password change revokes existing refresh sessions
Weak passwords are rejected for new users (min length)
Staff → 23 Owner-only endpoints all return 403 with no data
Staff cannot promote themselves (PATCH own user → 403)
Staff view of a booking hides finance data (linked costs, margin)
Staff cannot change recorded payments (finance data) on a completed booking
Staff cannot set a price adjustment, even by crafting the request
Mass assignment: server-owned fields in the body are ignored (status, total, paid, number, createdBy)
Idempotency keys are per user: Staff reusing Owner's key cannot read Owner's booking
Secrets are never returned: Google refresh token absent from /settings (Owner and Staff)
SQL injection: 5 payloads × search/filter params — no error, no leak, no delay
SQL injection via path IDs is blocked by UUID validation (400)
Stored XSS payloads are stored as plain text (rendered escaped by React — checked in browser)
Template injection: client data containing {placeholders} is not expanded
CSV/formula injection: a client named =HYPERLINK(...) is neutralised in the CSV export
Header injection: CR/LF in the client name cannot inject headers into the PDF download
wa.me link parameters are URL-encoded (no parameter smuggling via message text)
HTML/SVG/script files are rejected even when declared as images
Oversized upload (6 MB) is refused
JPEG/HTML polyglot is stored under a random key and served with nosniff (no HTML execution)
